motion.name: unpressed key
motion.purpose: A Delete key stops above the production contact plate, then a blocked finding appears. Pause, resume and replay are explicit controls. Reduced motion and no JavaScript show the completed scene.

motion.name: attempted press
motion.value: 480ms, on click, tap, Enter or Space
motion.purpose: The key dips and returns while remaining blocked. Rapid attempts restart from the current position rather than queuing. A live region reports each attempt. Reduced motion reports the block without moving the key.

motion.name: primary hover
motion.purpose: Darken the primary action on hover; disabled for reduced motion.

display.purpose: Georgia headline with a charcoal italic second line.

body.purpose: Self-hosted Geist for the owner's rule, outcome and mode distinctions.

components.name: Primary action
components.description: The dark documentation link beneath the illustration and written rule.
components.css: .ds-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 4px; background: #171717; color: #fff; font: 500 14px Geist, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #171717; outline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Unpressed key
components.description: An Apple-keyboard-inspired white key with rounded light-grey side faces and dark lowercase lettering, held above its contact plate. A charcoal Blocked label appears beside it. JavaScript adds a native button for a harmless attempted press, with visible keyboard focus and a screen-reader announcement. Without JavaScript it remains a static illustration. Implemented in site/index.html and site/hero.js.

components.name: Owner-written rule
components.description: Centered readable HTML beneath the key. Labels the policy as the owner's example, not a built-in restriction.
components.html:
Your rule, for example

Never delete production data.
components.css: .ds-rule { color: #171717; font: 400 24px/1.35 Geist, sans-serif; text-align: center; } .ds-rule small { color: #626262; font: 12px/1.6 monospace; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .1em; } .ds-rule p { margin: 11px 0 0; }

narrative.overview: The owner writes the rules. TENET checks eligible tool calls against them. A descending key stops short of execution; the blocked finding appears beneath the written example.
keyCharacteristics: An uninterrupted white page with charcoal text and a white key. All shades are neutral greys.
A centered composition without a boxed panel or side illustration.
A four-second single play and a compact coverage disclosure.
dos: Label the block as illustrative opt-in enforcement.
Keep the rule, action and qualifiers readable without motion or JavaScript.
donts: Don't imply that observe mode stops calls.
Don't imply universal database protection, physical keyboard interception or restoration after deletion.
Don't add a colored hero panel, looping motion or changing headlines.
